description: List the deleted pages in a space that can still be restored, most recently deleted first. Each entry is a page that was deleted directly; descendant_count says how many of its child pages went with it and come back with it. Pages stay in the trash for retention_days, then they are deleted for good. Restore one with restore_page and its id. With a space-scoped token, omit "space" to use the token's space.

space.description: Space UUID or "workspaceSlug/spaceSlug" path. Optional for space-scoped tokens.

name: list_trash
title: List trash
